correctness.rationale: Support functions prove the exact odd-sign and coordinate inequality description of the demihypercube. Pair flips at any nearest even sign vertex imply all pairwise coordinate sums are nonnegative. This yields lower coordinate bounds and controls odd-sign facets separately for one and at least three negative signs, using (n-2)(d-2)>=2 for n>=4. Thus the proposed remainder lies in the polytope. Every forbidden odd-sign facet is an (n-1)-simplex and its centroid makes the scaling n-1 necessary. All quantifiers, every tie of nearest vertices, n=4 and n=3 boundary, and the index normalization are explicit. An independently executable standard-library program checks 7,927 exact rational assertions for n=4,...,8; this is corroborative and not the proof.

value.rationale: A natural high-dimensional parity polytope with exponentially many vertices admits a linear-time canonical vertex witness for optimal Minkowski generation, valid for all Euclidean nearest vertices, not just an existential union covering. Pair-flip normal-cone inequalities translate into exact inclusion in every parity facet and yield a useful Voronoi-cell-wise containment theorem. The stronger pointwise statement is not given by the known facet principle which already fixes the isolated Schneider index; the complete family and sharp boundary make the structural result meaningful. n=3 exception and n=4 cross-polytope equivalence are explicitly accounted for.
